name: blanc Honeypot for Contact Form 7
author: blancto

sections.description:
This plugin adds a hidden “honeypot” field to every Contact Form 7 form on your site. Real visitors never see or fill in this field, but simple spam bots that auto-fill every input on a page will. When the honeypot field is filled in, Contact Form 7 silently marks the submission as spam and no notification email is sent.

Key points:

  • No settings screen — install, activate, and it works.
  • The hidden field’s name is generated randomly per site, so it is harder for spam operators to learn and target.
  • No CAPTCHA and no visible challenge for real visitors.
  • Does nothing if Contact Form 7 is not installed or active — no admin notices, no errors.
  • No external requests, no tracking, no data ever leaves your site.

This plugin does not modify your form templates, and it does not guarantee that all spam will be blocked. It is one additional layer of defense, best used alongside Contact Form 7’s own spam handling (and Akismet, if you use it).

（日本語）Contact Form 7 の全フォームに、目には見えない「ハニーポット」欄を自動で追加するプラグインです。人には見えない欄にスパムボットが入力すると、その送信を自動でスパム扱いにしてメール通知を止めます。設定画面はなく、有効化するだけで動作します。隠し欄の名前はサイトごとにランダムに生成されるため、ボットに学習されにくくなっています。Contact Form 7 が無効・未インストールの場合は何もしません。
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/blanc-honeypot-for-contact-form-7 directory, or install the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Contact Form 7 is installed and active. No further configuration is needed.
sections.faq:
Does this replace Contact Form 7’s own spam filtering?

No. It adds one additional, invisible check. Contact Form 7’s own spam filtering (and Akismet, if you use it) still runs as normal.

Will this block all spam?

No plugin can guarantee that. This reduces spam from simple bots that fill in every field on a form; it is not a complete solution against sophisticated or human-operated spam.

Does this add anything visible to my form?

No. The added field is hidden from sighted visitors and marked aria-hidden="true" so screen readers skip it too.

Does this send any data outside my site?

No. Everything happens locally on your server; the plugin makes no external requests.

What happens if I deactivate Contact Form 7?

The plugin stops doing anything. It only hooks into Contact Form 7’s own filters, so with Contact Form 7 inactive there is nothing for it to hook into.

What data does this plugin store?

Two options: the randomly generated field name, and a count of blocked submissions (shown on the Plugins screen). Both are deleted when the plugin is uninstalled.
